method: Independent ASR of delivered MP3s, no authored-text prompt; punctuation/case/apostrophe and 20-to-twenty normalization only. Automated proxy, not human listening acceptance.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.authoredText: Show me the part you want me to act on. Your private notes are not a public instruction.
lines.transcription: Show me the part you want me to act on. Your private notes are not a public instruction.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.authoredText: This packet has the cancellation receipt. Keep its limits on the cover. My request cannot turn it into independent proof.
lines.transcription: This packet has the cancellation receipt, keep its limits on the cover, my request cannot turn it into independent proof.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.authoredText: You put the ledger beside the receipt. That supports the cancellation. A worker's name is still not an issuing key.
lines.transcription: You put the ledger beside the receipt, that supports the cancellation. A worker's name is still not an issuing key.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.authoredText: A public review can change the depot's doors. A private query asks for an appointment. Neither puts my archive shift back.
lines.transcription: A public review can change the depot's doors. A private query asks for an appointment. Neither puts my archive shift back.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.authoredText: You showed me the source summary. Leave the witness out of my errands. I don't need a person's address to ask about a shift.
lines.transcription: You showed me the source summary. Leave the witness out of my errands. I don't need a person's address to ask about a shift.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.authoredText: My name went into their register after you promised it wouldn't. Say that before you ask me for another introduction.
lines.transcription: My name went into their register after you promised it wouldn't. Say that before you ask me for another introduction.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.authoredText: Keep the docket beside the promise. Use your own name for anything you sign. Mine stays out of it.
lines.transcription: Keep the docket beside the promise. Use your own name for anything you sign. Mine stays out of it.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.authoredText: Then I won't introduce you. The counter can answer for itself. I won't answer for a promise you won't name.
lines.transcription: Then I won't introduce you. The counter can answer for itself. I won't answer for a promise you won't name.

lines.speaker: Dispatcher
lines.authoredText: Sign only as the worker. No recipient name goes on the shift sheet. Finish the sorting and I pay twenty.
lines.transcription: Sign only as the worker. No recipient name goes on the shift sheet. Finish the sorting and I pay 20.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.authoredText: The depot answered a request. That is not an answer to the records inquiry. Keep both outcomes on the page.
lines.transcription: The depot answered a request that is not an answer to the record's inquiry. Keep both outcomes on the page.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.authoredText: A depot reference points to a desk. It doesn't tell me what you kept in your coat. What are you asking me to carry?
lines.transcription: A depot reference points to a desk. It doesn't tell me what you kept in your coat. What are you asking me to carry?

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.authoredText: Then I know which depot desk you asked for, not what's in your case. Keep those two things separate.
lines.transcription: Then I know which depot desk you asked for, not what's in your case. Keep those two things separate.
